name: powerskills-tool
description: Progressive-disclosure workflows for power-system software exposed by PowerMCP: ANDES, Egret, LTSpice, OpenDSS, PSLF, PSS/E, PowerWorld, PyPSA, pandapower, and surge. Each skill exposes load, inspect, solve, modify, then advanced studies, so an agent starts with the lowest-risk action and only escalates once the base case is credible.
